description: No official bulk data dump / full-archive export endpoint for the Prozorro CDB was located. Searches for public.docs.openprocurement.org, public.api.openprocurement.org and an OCDS mirror returned only a legacy reference to ocds.prozorro.openprocurement.io, which is old and could not be confirmed as current.

result.result_summary: Only the incremental REST change-feed (public-api.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/...) and the data.gov.ua CKAN dataset were confirmed as bulk-ish routes; no single downloadable archive was found.

why_it_matters: A full historical backfill of banking/payments tenders will require a long paginated crawl of the change feed rather than a one-shot download; collection effort and runtime must be planned accordingly.

description: The openprocurement.api overview page does not state the production API host, sandbox host, authentication requirements for read access, or rate limits.

result.result_summary: Fetched https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html — it defines only JSON/UTF-8 conventions. Host names (public-api.prozorro.gov.ua, api.prozorro.gov.ua) were inferred from live document URLs seen in search results, not from a documentation statement.

why_it_matters: Base URL and rate-limit assumptions are unconfirmed; a collector built on them must be defensive (backoff, 429 handling) and the hosts must be validated by the deterministic liveness pass.

description: Local-language searching for BI Prozorro analytics specifically covering payment terminals / ATMs returned no ready-made category dashboard.

result.result_summary: Searched 'bi.prozorro.org аналітика модуль закупівлі платіжні термінали' — results covered the BI module generally (how to use it, who built it) but no banking/payments category cut exists as a published view.

why_it_matters: Category sizing for banking/payments must be produced by us from CPV-filtered raw data; there is no authoritative third-party category baseline to lean on or cross-check against.

description: A distinct host 'market.prozorro.gov.ua' for Prozorro Market was searched for but never observed in results; the e-catalogue is presented under the main portal path /ProzorroMarket and via broker sites.

result.result_summary: No evidence found for a separate market.* hostname. Recorded the portal path instead. Do not assume the market subdomain exists.

why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated endpoint entering the source register; e-catalogue data should be pulled through the CDB API's price-quotation/catalogue families instead.

description: Zakupivli24 (PrivatBank's tender platform, privatbank.ua/zakupivli24) — named in this cell's scope — appears to have wound down its tender hosting: search results indicate tenders published up to 14 June 2023 remained active only until 1 September 2023, after which users were told to complete procedures or transfer them to another platform, with a recommendation to move to Prozorro. Not verified by direct fetch in this pass.

result.result_summary: Likely discontinued/redirected as an active tender-hosting marketplace; the landing page may still exist. Treat as UNVERIFIED, not confirmed dead. It is also absent from the current accredited list on prozorro.gov.ua/for-places.

why_it_matters: A bank-operated marketplace would have been the single most on-topic source in this cell. Its apparent closure means bank-side commercial sourcing is now dispersed across generic marketplaces, raising collection cost. Historical Zakupivli24 archives (if recoverable) would still be valuable for 2016-2023 baselines.

description: Targeted Ukrainian queries combining marketplace names with banking/payments vocabulary (банківське обладнання, еквайринг, термінали, інкасація) returned platform/company descriptions but no retrievable sector-specific tender listings via general web search.

result.result_summary: Marketplace tender listings are rendered behind on-site search/JS and are not indexed at the notice level by general search engines.

why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be worked by search-engine queries alone: collection must go through each platform's own search UI/API or through the central Prozorro OpenData API keyed by CPV/DK021 codes. Budget for per-platform integration accordingly.

description: Canonical domains for several currently accredited operators listed on prozorro.gov.ua/for-places were not resolved in this pass: Держзакупівлі.Онлайн, Public Bid (ТОВ "ІТ Контракт"), Zakupki UA (ТОВ "ЗАКУПІВЛІ ЮА"), E ЛОT, Govmarket.place (ТОВ "БІРЖА "РИНОК КАПІТАЛУ"), tender360.com.ua, and NEWTEND (domain inferred, not confirmed).

result.result_summary: Operator names captured from the official register; URLs not individually verified. No fabricated URLs were recorded for these.

why_it_matters: Leaves ~6 accredited operators only partially documented. The register page itself carries the authoritative links, so this is a cheap gap to close in a follow-up fetch pass.

description: Searches for 'tenderguru' / 'tenders.guru' style international aggregators covering Ukraine returned no Ukrainian-relevant results in this pass.

result.result_summary: No evidence found in this pass that an international aggregator provides distinct UA banking-tender coverage beyond the domestic operators.

why_it_matters: Suggests foreign-language aggregation adds little; effort should concentrate on Ukrainian-language domestic platforms. Should be re-tested with EN queries in a later pass before being treated as settled.

description: Pricing, coverage and API availability for the paid monitoring tier (Clarity Project, YouControl, the Prozorro paid analytics module, marketplace premium tariffs) could not be established from public pages in this pass.

result.result_summary: Existence of paid tiers confirmed; terms, API access and per-seat cost not established.

why_it_matters: Determines whether the programme can automate collection under licence or must rely on scraping public surfaces — a material design decision for the collector.

description: Searched in Ukrainian for DOZORRO investigations specifically about banking IT / banking equipment procurement ('DoZorro розслідування закупівля банківське ІТ обладнання').

result.result_summary: No DOZORRO investigation dedicated to banking/payments hardware or banking IT surfaced. Results returned only generic monitoring pages, complaint guidance, and unrelated blog analyses.

why_it_matters: Suggests the watchdog layer does not treat banking/payments procurement as a named vertical; sector signal must be extracted by filtering their generic datasets (BI Prozorro, Clarity) by CPV/keywords rather than by reading a curated sector page.

description: WebFetch of https://dozorro.org/tools and https://ti-ukraine.org/en/ti_format/research/public-procurement/

result.result_summary: Both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. Treated as bot-defended-but-live (both are widely linked and indexed), NOT as dead.

why_it_matters: The two most central sources of this cell cannot be collected by plain HTTP fetch; the pipeline needs headless-browser collection or an official data route.

description: Cell brief implied 'Centre of Excellence in Procurement' sits at Kyiv-Mohyla Business School (KMBS).

result.result_summary: The Centre of Excellence in Procurement (Центр вдосконалення закупівель) is hosted at Kyiv School of Economics — cep.kse.ua. KMBS (EDRPOU 31608498) is a distinct institution with no procurement centre found.

why_it_matters: Prevents mis-attributed sourcing and wasted crawls against the wrong institution.

description: Searched (en) for a Ukraine-specific single-bidder analysis covering banking technology tenders.

result.result_summary: Found general Ukrainian single-bid findings (single-bid contracts ~7% more expensive; competitive share 24.5%→70.3% 2015-2017) and the GTI/opentender methodological framework, but no banking-technology cut.

why_it_matters: No off-the-shelf sector benchmark exists; the run must compute its own single-bid rate for banking/payments CPVs.

description: bi.prozorro.org and bipro.prozorro.org root URLs were inferred from consistent references in DOZORRO and Infobox articles, not fetched directly in this pass.

result.result_summary: Hostnames are stated repeatedly by primary DOZORRO/Infobox sources; liveness not independently confirmed here.

why_it_matters: Deterministic verification pass should confirm before these become collection anchors.

description: No authoritative source located for 'City24' as a Ukrainian utility-payment kiosk / self-service terminal operator despite it being named in the cell definition.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language query on iBox/EasyPay/City24 returned nothing on City24; the search assistant explicitly noted no City24 results. It may be a brand of another operator, a defunct network, or a name confusion.

why_it_matters: If City24 is a real acceptance network, its absence leaves a gap in the utility-kiosk segment; if it is not, the cell definition should be corrected so downstream runs stop chasing it.

description: Could not identify named vendors/integrators of e-ticket validator hardware in Ukraine from the query terms tried ('Смарт Тікет', 'УКРКАРТ', 'СмартТранзит').

result.result_summary: Those guessed company names returned no matches. Only municipal buyers surfaced (KP GIOTs as Kyiv E-ticket operator, Kyivpastrans buying validators, Kyiv Metro buying QR readers).

why_it_matters: The supply side of the validator/e-ticket market is the commercially interesting half. It must be recovered from Prozorro award records (supplier field) rather than by guessing brand names.

description: iBox Bank's licence was revoked and the bank liquidated (NBU decision, 7 March), after which iBox terminals stopped accepting payments for any services.

result.result_summary: Reported in search results on the iBox terminal network; the network is described elsewhere as ~6,800 terminals in 200 cities carrying ~2,500 services.

why_it_matters: One of the largest non-bank cash-acceptance networks in the cell may be defunct or restructured. Historical iBox tender/partner data must be treated as stale, and the vacated utility-payment volume is a live demand signal for competitors.

description: Some city e-ticket operator selections were advertised in local newspapers rather than in Prozorro or on specialised e-procurement platforms.

result.result_summary: Reported in Ukrainian regional coverage of e-ticket implementation; flagged there as a transparency problem.

why_it_matters: A meaningful slice of municipal payments demand is structurally invisible to any Prozorro-only collection strategy. Regional press monitoring is not optional for this cell — it is the only channel.

description: No Ukrainian-language source found announcing acquiring/POS-terminal tenders run by fuel-retail networks (OKKO, WOG, SOCAR, UPG) or large grocery chains.

result.result_summary: The АЗС+еквайринг query returned only fuel-price news, network rankings, and generic explainers on what acquiring is; no procurement announcements.

why_it_matters: Private-sector acceptance procurement in Ukraine appears to run through bilateral negotiation, not published tenders. This segment likely needs an indirect method (partner announcements, association news, terminal-branding observation) rather than tender monitoring.

description: PSP corporate newsrooms (Fondy, WayForPay, LiqPay/Privat, Portmone, EasyPay) were not individually fetched in this pass; only aggregator and comparison coverage of them was found.

result.result_summary: Their existence is well attested across multiple independent guides, but exact newsroom/press-release URLs are unconfirmed and the Fondy domain above is inferred, not verified.

why_it_matters: PSP partner and vendor selections are announced on their own channels first. These need a dedicated enumeration pass to pin down per-company news feed URLs.

description: No Ukraine-specific press release or customer-reference page was found on the newsrooms of the two dominant ATM OEMs (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf) naming a Ukrainian bank deployment.

result.result_summary: English searches returned only global product/strategy news and Russia-exit coverage; no UA deal announcement surfaced in the first pages of results.

why_it_matters: ATM/recycler supply into Ukraine is a core question for this cell; if OEMs do not announce locally, the deal record must be reconstructed from local partners, bank fleet pages and service tenders instead.

description: No official OEM partner/distributor locator for Ukraine was found for Ingenico, PAX or Verifone.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search surfaced only self-declared reseller claims (GeneralPay) and bank help pages listing models; no authoritative OEM partner list for UA.

why_it_matters: Without an OEM-authoritative list, the local partner field must be assembled bottom-up from self-claims, which are weaker evidence and need triangulation.

description: 'Printec' resolves to at least two unrelated Ukrainian entities: printec.com.ua (banking/self-service technology) and printec.ua (retail/office equipment shop).

result.result_summary: Search results mixed the two domains under one brand name.

why_it_matters: Automated crawling keyed on the brand name will contaminate the dataset; the collector must pin the domain, not the name.

description: Ukrainian terminology for cash-recycling ATMs is unstable — 'банкомат з рециркуляцією', 'ресайклер', 'ресайклінговий банкомат', 'депозитний модуль' all appear; the seed query using 'рециркуляція' returned no vendor press releases.

result.result_summary: No usable hits for the recycling-ATM seed query in uk.

why_it_matters: Query design for this subtopic needs the full alias set plus English-in-Ukrainian forms, otherwise recycler deployments will be systematically missed.

description: SI BIS corporate domain was not directly confirmed in results; only third-party profiles (crm.ua/sibis, compu.fandom.com) were seen.

result.result_summary: sibis.com.ua is a plausible but unconfirmed canonical host.

why_it_matters: The URL must be resolved by the deterministic verification pass before it enters the collection set.

description: No Ukraine-specific ATM / self-service / cash-handling trade exhibition with a published exhibitor list was found. English-language searches returned only non-Ukrainian events (PAY360 London, ATMIA roadshows, Fintech Poland Expo).

result.result_summary: Ukrainian coverage of the ATM/self-service hardware channel appears to happen inside general fintech/payments conferences rather than a dedicated expo; no UA exhibitor directory located in this pass.

why_it_matters: Exhibitor lists are the cleanest enumeration of hardware/service suppliers competing for bank ATM and self-service tenders; without one, supplier discovery must rely on association partner lists and Prozorro award history.

description: For UAFIC (fintechua.org), UCBS (ukbs.org.ua) and AUB (aub.org.ua) the existence of a public, machine-readable member roster page was not confirmed from search snippets alone; only the association homepages/about pages were surfaced.

result.result_summary: Membership counts were reported in secondary text (e.g. UCBS ~92 institutions, EMA ~64 organisations) but the canonical listing URLs were not established in this pass.

why_it_matters: The member rosters are the core POINTER deliverable of this cell; if some are PDF-only, members-only or absent, the actor map must be assembled from event participant lists and registry data instead.

description: LinkedIn — where Ukrainian banks and vendors most visibly post procurement/vendor-management roles and event announcements — is behind a login wall and its terms forbid automated collection.

result.result_summary: Only a single public post URL (UAFIC Ukrainian Banking Summit announcement) was reachable via search.

why_it_matters: A significant share of the hiring weak signal for senior procurement roles at banks is on LinkedIn; excluding it biases coverage toward mass-market job boards and junior roles.

description: The acronym 'НАБУ' collides between the banking association (Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України) and the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine; 'ЄМА/ЕМА' collides with unrelated brand names.

result.result_summary: Local-language queries on НАБУ return heavy anti-corruption noise unless combined with 'асоціація банків' or the nabu.ua domain.

why_it_matters: Automated keyword monitoring on these acronyms will produce large false-positive volume; queries must be domain- or phrase-anchored.

description: NABU appears under both 'Незалежна асоціація банків України' and 'Національна Асоціація Банків України' across its own pages and third-party references.

result.result_summary: Both variants were observed on nabu.ua-linked results in this pass; the current official Ukrainian name was not verified.

why_it_matters: Entity resolution and query construction need both variants plus EDRPOU 37924657 to avoid missing content.

description: Targeted uk-language searching for oblast military administrations procuring cash-handling equipment, ATMs or cash desks returned only generic ОВА procurement pages and no concrete tender records for банкомат / обладнання для обслуговування готівки.

result.result_summary: ОВА sites confirm a 'публічні закупівлі' section pattern, but no cash-infrastructure line items surfaced at search-engine level.

why_it_matters: Such purchases likely exist but are only discoverable by CPV-level querying inside Prozorro/Spending, not via web search; the collection design must not rely on search engines for this layer.

description: Defence Procurement Agency (ДОТ) states that certain procurement information is not disclosed publicly under martial-law legislation; there appears to be no public itemised register of its closed purchases.

result.result_summary: MoD explanation pages describe information-security regime rather than publishing procurement detail.

why_it_matters: A structurally significant share of spend is legally unobservable in real time; only post-hoc audit reports (Рахункова палата) and deferred Prozorro reporting can partially close this gap.

description: Could not retrieve a definitive, itemised list of exemption grounds (the specific numbered points of Resolution 1178 permitting direct contracts) from secondary sources; commentary confirms the list has been repeatedly expanded but summaries are partial.

result.result_summary: Trade press confirms expansion of direct-contract grounds; exact enumeration not captured in this pass.

why_it_matters: The exemption enumeration is the backbone for classifying observed contracts; it must be read directly from the consolidated act text rather than commentary.

description: No dedicated English-language authoritative source was found for the wartime exemption regime; English coverage is confined to NGO/analysis summaries (TI Ukraine, law-firm briefings).

result.result_summary: English sources are derivative, not primary.

why_it_matters: Confirms that uk-language collection is mandatory for this cell; an English-only pipeline would systematically miss the regime.

description: No dedicated procurement/tender section on Oschadbank's own website (oschadbank.ua) could be located. A direct fetch of https://www.oschadbank.ua/tenderi failed with a redirect loop, and repeated Ukrainian-language site-targeted searches returned only third-party aggregators (tender.uub.com.ua, gov.e-tender.ua) rather than a bank-hosted page.

result.result_summary: Only an incidental Prozorro notice referencing an oschadbank.ua contact mailbox was found; no buyer-side terms page confirmed.

why_it_matters: Oschadbank is the largest state retail bank by branch and ATM footprint; without its own buyer page, buyer-side supplier requirements and historical award terms must be reconstructed entirely from Prozorro records, losing the qualitative detail this cell was meant to capture.

description: No supplier/procurement page was found on Sense Bank's own domains (sensebank.ua / sensebank.com.ua) despite Ukrainian-language searching. Secondary text encountered asserts Sense Bank does not consider itself a 'Замовник' under the public procurement law, yet Sense Bank tenders do appear on Prozorro.

result.result_summary: Prozorro buyer records exist under EDRPOU 23494714; no bank-hosted procurement page confirmed.

why_it_matters: Ambiguous legal status means an unknown share of Sense Bank's spend may be procured off-Prozorro with no public trace — a structural blind spot rather than a missing document.

description: English-language searching for Ukrainian state-bank equipment procurement (e.g. 'Oschadbank ATM procurement tender award supplier cash recycler Prozorro 2025') returned essentially zero relevant results — the result set was dominated by Indian and UK tender aggregators.

result.result_summary: English queries are near-useless for this cell; all productive discovery came from Ukrainian-language queries.

why_it_matters: Confirms that any collection pipeline for UA state-bank procurement must be built on Ukrainian query terms and Ukrainian-language CPV/item descriptions; an English-only monitor would report a false absence of demand.

description: Two buyer-owned pages returned no extractable content on first fetch: ukrgasbank.com/about/tender_committee/ (empty body) and tender.privatbank.ua (empty body after two 302 hops to /commercial/tender).

result.result_summary: Both are treated as bot-defended or JS-rendered hypotheses, not as dead sources; linked documents from both domains are independently indexed.

why_it_matters: A naive liveness check would wrongly mark two of the five state-bank buyer portals as dead; they require headless rendering.

description: PrivatBank's former procurement platform zakupivli24.pb.ua appears to have been disabled (secondary reporting indicates mid-2023), with procurement moved to tender.privatbank.ua and Prozorro.

result.result_summary: Legacy domain should not be used as a live collection target; may still hold archival value if snapshots exist.

why_it_matters: Historical award series for PrivatBank may be split across a retired platform and the current one, breaking longitudinal supplier analysis.

description: No evidence found that PrJSC Ukrainian Processing Centre (EDRPOU 24747867) publishes procurement notices or acts as a Prozorro buyer.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search combining the company name with 'Prozorro' and 'закупівлі' returned only registry-aggregator profiles (YouControl, Opendatabot, ua-region) and unrelated tenders. UPC is a private joint-stock company and is outside the Public Procurement Law's buyer scope.

why_it_matters: A major processing-infrastructure operator in this cell is structurally invisible to tender-based collection; its technology purchases must be inferred from vendor announcements, NBU registers and financial statements instead.

description: No dedicated public tender/procurement section was located for the PROSTIR / NPSMU card scheme as a distinct buyer.

result.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for ПРОСТІР/НПСМУ + тендер/закупівля returned scheme description pages on bank.gov.ua and prostir.gov.ua plus Wikipedia, but no scheme-level procurement notices. PROSTIR appears to procure through the NBU legal entity rather than separately.

why_it_matters: Card-scheme technology purchases must be tracked under the NBU's own EDRPOU (00032106) rather than under a PROSTIR-branded buyer; a collection rule keyed on 'ПРОСТІР' as a buyer name would return nothing.

description: bank.gov.ua rejected an unauthenticated plain fetch with HTTP 403.

result.result_summary: GET https://bank.gov.ua/ua/about/procurements returned 403 Forbidden with no body. The site is widely linked and clearly operational, so this reads as WAF/bot defence rather than a dead endpoint — recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: The single most authoritative source in this cell needs a browser-grade fetch path; a naive crawler would silently record the central bank's procurement hub as unavailable.

description: No explicit list of SEP participants as procurement buyers was retrieved in this pass.

result.result_summary: The NBU payment-systems register pages were identified as the likely home of SEP/PROSTIR participant lists, but the pages were not fetched because of the 403 on the parent domain. Participant enumeration remains outstanding.

why_it_matters: The state-owned SEP participants (Oschadbank, Ukreximbank, Ukrgasbank, PrivatBank) are themselves Prozorro-obliged buyers of payment technology, and without the participant list their EDRPOU codes are not yet in the watchlist.

description: No supplier-registration, procurement-policy or tender page could be located for AT Universal Bank / monobank despite Ukrainian-language querying combining the bank name with закупівлі, тендер and постачальники.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only product, partnership-project and Wikipedia material. The only procurement-adjacent hit was a Prozorro.sale document where the bank appears as a financial service provider, not as a buyer.

why_it_matters: Universal Bank/monobank is one of the fastest-growing IT-intensive banks in Ukraine and a plausible large buyer of payment and technology hardware/services. Its vendor spend is currently entirely opaque, leaving a real hole in the non-state demand picture.

description: No procurement or supplier-onboarding section was located for A-Bank (abank.ua).

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language queries on the bank name plus тендер/закупівлі/постачальникам returned only unrelated Prozorro records where banks appear as service providers, and pages belonging to other institutions (PrivatBank, Ukrgasbank, UkrSibbank, NBU).

why_it_matters: A-Bank is a sizeable retail/card issuer in the cell. Absence of any published vendor channel means it can only ever be reached through the commercial marketplaces or direct outreach, which should be reflected in coverage expectations.

description: PUMB (First Ukrainian International Bank) has no discoverable procurement or supplier-registration page on its own web properties.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language queries surfaced only PUMB's client-facing business banking, factoring-for-Prozorro-suppliers products, and document templates. The only buy-side visibility found was PUMB's issuer page on the Zakupivli.Pro commercial marketplace (EDRPOU 14282829).

why_it_matters: PUMB is the largest Ukrainian-capital private bank in the cell; the fact that its only public procurement window is a third-party marketplace confirms the cell's core hypothesis and makes marketplace coverage non-optional rather than supplementary.

description: ProCredit Bank Ukraine's tender page presents itself as a tender listing but its most recent entries date from 2008.

result.result_summary: Fetched page shows completed tenders for 2008-2009 (vehicle insurance, website development, office-equipment vendors) and no active procurements; the live element is a cooperation-proposal intake form.

why_it_matters: Demonstrates that the presence of a bank tender page is not evidence of an active feed. Any verification pass should distinguish 'page live' from 'content current', or the source inventory will overstate real coverage.

description: BNP Paribas Group states it does not practise open bidding, which structurally caps what UkrSibbank can ever publish.

result.result_summary: Group supplier page: suppliers are either added to a preferred-supplier list following a call for tenders or picked for a specific project, with pre-qualification on financial soundness and economic dependence; contracting runs through the group OneProcTool/Ivalua platform.

why_it_matters: Confirms that the absence of a UkrSibbank tender board is deliberate policy, not a discovery failure. Collection effort for this bank should be redirected from tender-watching to onboarding-channel and group-policy monitoring.

description: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine's actual tender workflow runs on Oracle iProcurement and a Microsoft Forms supplier questionnaire, neither of which exposes a public listing.

result.result_summary: The public procurement page names the tooling and the intake form but publishes no tender announcements; announcements appear instead on E-Tender and Zakupivli.Pro.

why_it_matters: The authoritative system of record is closed. Collection must rely on the marketplace mirrors, which may carry only a subset of the bank's procurements — coverage from these feeds should be treated as partial by construction.

description: The Ukrainian/Russian term 'тендер' plus a bank name is heavily polluted by sell-side and unrelated results.

result.result_summary: Queries repeatedly returned tender-guarantee products (тендерна гарантія) that banks sell to bidders, Prozorro records where the bank is the winning provider of banking services, and Russian-market Raiffeisenbank RU results (rostender.info, zakupki.kontur.ru) that must be excluded.

why_it_matters: Without disambiguation a collector will conflate a bank selling tender guarantees with a bank buying goods, and will pull Russian-jurisdiction data into a Ukraine run. Noisy terms must be flagged and the Russian domains blocklisted.

description: No general procurement or vendor page was located for Bank Pivdenny; only a statutory audit-firm selection competition was observed.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search surfaced the bank's tender-guarantee product page and an audit-firm selection competition dated 14.08.2026, but no procurement section. Note the bank operates on bank.com.ua rather than the assumed pivdenny.ua.

why_it_matters: For this bank the only forced-disclosure lever is regulatory (mandatory audit selection). Domain assumptions in the seed brief were wrong, which is itself a caution for automated URL construction.

description: No EBRD Ukraine procurement notice specifically scoped to a bank payment system / payment infrastructure consultancy was surfaced by the seed query. UA notices found were procurement-reform, project-implementation-support and FIDIC-engineer assignments.

result.result_summary: ECEPP confirmed as the live UA notice channel, but the specific payments-technology assignment was not located from open web search; it would require an in-portal filtered search (sector = financial institutions).

why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis (donor notices precede national tenders for payment infrastructure) is plausible but not yet evidenced; a portal-side search is needed before concluding absence.

description: Direct fetches of both https://dream.gov.ua/ and https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/procurement returned only client-side loading placeholders.

result.result_summary: No content extracted; both are single-page applications. Treated as unverified-but-presumed-live hypotheses, not dead sources.

why_it_matters: Two of the highest-priority sources in this cell cannot be collected by plain HTTP fetch; the collection design must budget for headless rendering or API discovery.

description: Platforms named 'RELINK', 'REPOWER' and 'PREPARE' were cited by a trade-body source as IFI-financed procurement channels for Ukraine alongside Prozorro and DREAM, but a targeted Ukrainian-language search returned no corroboration and no canonical URLs.

result.result_summary: Named-but-unconfirmed. No URL is recorded for them because none was actually found.

why_it_matters: If real, these are additional donor procurement pipelines outside both Prozorro and lender portals — a blind spot. If they are internal DREAM modules, that changes the collection design.

description: No Ukrainian-language donor-side terminology was found for payment-infrastructure-specific procurement objects (e.g. a standard UA phrase for 'payment terminal / acquiring system' in IFI notice titles); IFI notices addressed to UA are overwhelmingly published in English only.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language searching surfaced rules, commentary and press coverage (Prozorro Infobox, Mineconomy, KMU, NISS, AHK) but essentially no Ukrainian-language primary notices from EBRD/WB/UNDP.

why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language monitoring for this cell should target the meta/rules/commentary layer and Prozorro, not the lender portals; English is the operative notice language.

description: UNOPS eSourcing requires a UNGM vendor account; UNGM's alerting layer (Tender Alert Service / UNGM Pro) is a paid product; DevelopmentAid is membership-gated.

result.result_summary: Discovery-layer data remains publicly listed, but structured/alerting access is commercial.

why_it_matters: Automated near-real-time monitoring may require either registered accounts or polling the free public listings; ToS review is needed before any bulk collection.

description: USAID has been closed and its continuing Ukraine programmes, including oversight of direct budget support, transferred to the US Department of State; no successor Ukraine financial-sector solicitation was identified in open search.

result.result_summary: The USAID.gov / former USAID Ukraine procurement channel is no longer the right monitoring target; SAM.gov plus State Department country pages are.

why_it_matters: Historic collection rules pointing at USAID business-forecast pages would silently go stale and produce a false 'no US activity' signal.

description: No specific TED contract or award notice concerning Ukrainian banking/payment systems could be identified from search-engine results alone.

result.result_summary: General-web search surfaces TED as a platform but does not index individual TED notice pages well; notice-level discovery requires querying the TED Search API or Advanced Search directly with CPV and place-of-performance filters.

why_it_matters: Any collection design for this cell must be API-first. A web-search-based collector would systematically miss the very notices the cell exists to capture.

description: TED itself has no Ukrainian interface language and Ukrainian-language search terms return almost no TED notice-level content.

result.result_summary: The Ukrainian query 'оголошення TED Україна фінансові послуги закупівля ЄС' returned only explanatory/portal pages (MFA mission guide, Prozorro Infobox), no notices.

why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language monitoring cannot substitute for English TED monitoring in this cell; conversely, Ukrainian terms are the right tool for finding the bridging/explainer sources and for Prozorro-side donor procurement.

description: No established Ukrainian-language shorthand was found for 'Ukrainian entity as awardee on a foreign/EU portal'.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian sources speak of 'участь у публічних закупівлях ЄС' and 'ринок публічних закупівель ЄС' but there is no compact term equivalent to 'cross-border award', which weakens local-language querying for this specific angle.

why_it_matters: Local-language recall for cross-border awards is structurally limited; the reliable route is entity-name search (Ukrainian bank/PSP legal names and transliterations) against TED full text rather than concept search.

description: Ukraine Facility money is largely procured under Ukrainian national law via Prozorro, not via TED.

result.result_summary: Prozorro Infobox states procurement under the Ukraine Facility plan follows national legislation subject to the Framework Agreement; only EU-institution-contracted assistance goes through TED/Funding & Tenders Portal.

why_it_matters: This bounds the cell: the largest EU-funded euro volumes are visible nationally, while TED holds the EU-institution slice. Both must be tracked or spend will be double-counted or missed.

description: No liveness or access check was performed on any URL in this slice.

result.result_summary: All URLs are reported as discovered, with confidence scores; ECEPP notice-detail pages and DevelopmentAid records are known to sit behind registration/paywalls in part, but this was not confirmed by fetch.

why_it_matters: Downstream verification must treat blocked=true flags here as hypotheses, and a 403 on ted.europa.eu or ecepp.ebrd.com should be read as bot-defence, not as a dead source.

description: No search result surfaced any ready-made, sector-filtered view of Ukrainian treasury spending on banking equipment (ATMs, POS terminals, processing services). E-data/Spending and Prozorro expose generic transaction and contract layers only.

result.result_summary: English-language coverage of E-data explicitly contained nothing about payment terminals or ATM vendors; Ukrainian searches likewise returned only generic portal/API material.

why_it_matters: Any banking-hardware intelligence from this cell must be constructed by us via CPV-code and payment-purpose keyword filters; there is no off-the-shelf sectoral dataset to subscribe to.

description: The spending.gov.ua transactions API endpoint (api.spending.gov.ua/api/v2/api/transactions/) and the contracts endpoint were reported in search snippets and third-party docs, not confirmed by a direct fetch in this pass.

result.result_summary: Endpoint paths recorded from secondary references; exact base path, versioning and required parameters remain to be confirmed against the official Confluence manual.

why_it_matters: Building a collector on an unverified path risks silent failure; the deterministic liveness pass and a read of the Confluence API manual should precede implementation.

description: State-owned commercial banks (Oschadbank, PrivatBank) buy ATMs/POS through Prozorro but are not budget holders paying via the State Treasury, so their contract execution is largely invisible in spending.gov.ua transaction data.

result.result_summary: Bank buyer profiles appear on Prozorro mirrors; no evidence found of their payments in treasury transaction data.

why_it_matters: The most commercially relevant Ukrainian ATM/POS buyers may only be traceable through Prozorro contracts and contract-execution reports, not the treasury 'money moved' layer — this limits the ground-truth claim for the bank segment.

description: No dedicated Ukrainian-language register was found for post-award service/maintenance performance (SLA fulfilment) of banking equipment beyond the generic 'звіт про виконання договору' report in Prozorro.

result.result_summary: Searches on service maintenance of ATMs returned only generic procurement-control material.

why_it_matters: Recurring maintenance revenue must be inferred from repeating treasury payments to the same payee, not from an explicit service register.

description: None of the aggregators (Clarity Project, Opendatabot, YouControl, VKURSI) surfaced a ready-made banking/payments or ATM/POS vertical view in search results — no 'банкомати' or 'платіжні термінали' landing page, category or curated supplier list was found.

result.result_summary: Sector slicing must be constructed by us via CPV filters and KVED codes on top of generic company/tender search; no vendor offers a payments-industry cut off the shelf.

why_it_matters: Collection design cannot rely on a vendor-provided sector segment; we must own the CPV/KVED taxonomy that defines 'UA banking & payments technology supplier'.

description: The CPV code used in the seed exploration for ATMs (30160000, taken from the query formulation) was not confirmed against an authoritative CPV/ДК 021:2015 listing during this run.

result.result_summary: No source found in this run that states the exact ДК 021:2015 codes for ATMs, POS terminals, processing services or banking software.

why_it_matters: The whole supplier-enumeration approach hinges on the correct CPV set; an unverified code would silently truncate the supplier universe.

description: The AMCU 'Державний реєстр суб'єктів господарювання, притягнутих до відповідальності' was confirmed to exist via an AMCU news page and third-party commentary, but the direct register URL / dataset endpoint was not located in this run.

result.result_summary: Only the announcement page and secondary explainers were captured; the register's own address remains to be found on the AMCU site.

why_it_matters: The blacklist is a key screening feed; without a stable endpoint it cannot be automated.

description: Licensing and bulk-use terms for Clarity Project, YouControl and VKURSI were not read in this run; only pricing/feature pages were surfaced for Opendatabot and VKURSI.

result.result_summary: Whether systematic extraction is contractually permitted (vs. requiring an API/enterprise plan) is unresolved for the three most useful aggregators.

why_it_matters: Determines whether these become automated feeds or manual-lookup tools; scraping against ToS is a legal and continuity risk.

description: EDR open-data publication has been interrupted and only partly restored (reported January 2026), with defence-sector, arms-manufacturer and strategic-facility entries kept closed.

result.result_summary: Ownership/UBO coverage is incomplete by design for some entities; state-bank-adjacent or dual-use suppliers may be missing or thinned.

why_it_matters: Any beneficial-ownership map built now has known blind spots that must be declared in downstream analysis.

description: Targeted uk-language searches combining oversight bodies with banking/payments terms (Держаудитслужба + банк; Рахункова палата + платіжні системи / банківське обладнання) returned only generic process material, no sector-specific audit or monitoring documents in the search snapshot.

result.result_summary: Oversight bodies clearly cover procurement in general, but no banking/payments-specific audit report surfaced from search alone; sector filtering will have to happen inside the corpora (PDF full-text and API keyword/CPV filters), not via web search.

why_it_matters: Confirms that the collection design must be corpus-first (bulk pull + keyword/CPV filter) rather than query-first, or the banking/payments signal will be missed.

description: I did not find a public, machine-readable search endpoint or downloadable register of AMCU appeals-board decisions on amcu.gov.ua; the site section itself returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch.

result.result_summary: No confirmed AMCU decisions API or bulk export located in this run. Decision texts appear to reach the public mainly through the Prozorro electronic system and third-party digests (DOZORRO, RADNYK).

why_it_matters: Means the appeals stream should be collected primarily via Prozorro complaint objects, with amcu.gov.ua used as a corroborating/secondary source.

description: WebFetch on https://amcu.gov.ua/napryami/oskarzhennya-publichnih-zakupivel returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live (hypothesis), not dead. Requires a browser-like client to confirm.

why_it_matters: A naive collector will silently fail against AMCU; header/headless handling must be built in from the start.

description: Search material indicates the Prozorro statistical module showing detected procurement violations and their remediation status is still under development.

result.result_summary: No consolidated official violations dashboard confirmed; aggregate oversight statistics must be reconstructed from DASU reports and Prozorro raw objects.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations: there is no single ready-made 'violations' feed to subscribe to.

description: uk-language search for NABU/SAPO cases specifically about ATM/processing/banking-equipment procurement returned only unrelated state-bank corruption and money-laundering reporting.

result.result_summary: No NABU/SAPO case specifically on banking-equipment or processing procurement was identified in this run.

why_it_matters: The criminal-enforcement channel is real but low-yield for this sector; it should be a lower-frequency monitoring stream than AMCU/DASU.
